text:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: High KV cache churn observed in prod-us-west cluster — eviction rate 72% over 5m, continuous-batcher latency climb +3x, several OOMs on int8 runtime. Auto-ticket INC-1955 created. @oncall please acknowledge.

elaine: acked. Seeing same in grafana. Topline: batcher throughput looks normal but tail latency spikes, and many small shards showing kv_size increasing ~4x after the recent awq kernel switch.

samir: oncall handoff — i'm up for next 2h. quick context?

elaine: suspected regression from yesterday's runtime change that flips kernel selection to awq-int8 for gptq-variants. commit: 7a3f9b2 (runtime/kernel-selector). rolled at 02:14 UTC.

nikhil: confirmed correlation: before 02:14 median kv_entry_size ~1.1KB, after ~4.2KB on int8 models (esp awq/gptq combos). eviction loop triggered because prefix cache got bigger per-session.

rachel: customers: a handful of low-latency customers hitting 503s / slowed responses. Eng-sre dashboard shows spikes in 5xx for route /v1/chat/stream (hosted-prod-us-west). I can DM list to support.

elaine: first mitigation plan: (1) force kernel fallback for int8 -> fp16 path for affected model family (2) reduce continuous-batcher max_tokens_per_batch to 1024 as hotfix (3) enable prefix-kv-size cap in config.

samir: which of these are quick?

elaine: (1) and (2) are fast. (1) is a runtime flag flip: set KERNEL_SELECT_MODE=compat-awq-fallback on runtime hosts for prod-us-west pool. Deployment via deploy-bot in infra-runbooks. (2) is a config change to batcher service: PATCH /api/v1/configs/continuous-batcher with payload: ```{
  "max_tokens_per_batch": 1024
}```

eng-runtime-bot: deploy job queued: runtime/kernelselector-toggle -> job 98765. will report status.

mike-l2: i'm taking L2 standby in 10m. If we need kernel rollback + binary deploy, escalate.

nikhil: quick math: capping kv entry size at 2MB/session reduces eviction pressure by ~60% on sample traffic. we should apply cap as medium-term.

samir: ok do (1) and (2) now. elaine, trigger patch and i'll monitor.

elaine: PATCH issued to batcher and runtime flag flip initiated. deploy-bot: runtime/kernelselector-toggle succeeded on 6/7 hosts, rolling on last host now. batcher config PATCH returned 200.

eng-runtime-bot: last host update pending (node-ps-13), draining requests to migrate KV. ETA ~45s.

opsbot: notice: ephemeral throttles applied to continuous-batcher route by ops (feature-flag: cb_throttle_prod_usw). Reduced max concurrency by 40% to reduce burst KV allocation.

samir: seeing tail latency drop on /v1/chat/stream from 1200ms -> 420ms on median for affected traces. eviction metric falling.

rachel: 503 rate for affected customer group down to baseline. support notified and posting update. :thumbsup:

nikhil: logs show the kernel-selection path demoting to fallback on 6/7 hosts; last one still using awq. we may need to cordon node-ps-13 if it stalls.

elaine: i'm going to start a temporary feature-flag that forces quantization-path=fp16 for the 3 affected models while we debug kernel heuristics. Samir, please coordinate with Mike-L2 if we need faster rollback.

samir: ack. outline for handoff to L2: What I did: acknowledged, identified correlation with kernel switch, flipped flag + batcher cap, applied throttle. What I'm doing: monitoring metrics and logs, validating payload regressions. What I need: L2 to continue rolling last host, validate persistent storage not corrupted, and prepare postmortem blameless runbook.

mike-l2: taking over. will finish host roll and run kv-scan to ensure no corrupted entries. Also will check for customers with repeated retries.

rachel: creating incident page + customer-impact note. tagging cs-leads.

eng-runtime-bot: runtime/kernelselector-toggle job completed: success across all hosts.

nikhil: eviction rate now down to 12% and kv_size medians trending back to normal. continuous-batcher throughput recovering.

samir: excellent. saving action items: (A) revert kernel heuristic change until we have size model (B) add unit test for kv_estimate after quantized kernels (C) add telemetry: per-session kv_entry_size by kernel type (D) postmortem to be owned by elaine/nikhil.

elaine: agreed. I'll open a PR to revert 7a3f9b2 and start the postmortem doc. assigning DRI: elaine, co-DRI: nikhil.

mike-l2: leaving handoff notes in INC-1955: runbook steps, last known good commit 7a3f9b2~1 (6c2b4fa), rollback instructions, and customer list.

samir: thanks team. I'll mark incident as mitigated in 20m if metrics hold. please add any missing customer hits to the ticket. :heart:

incident-bot: incident INC-1955 status changed -> mitigated -> monitoring.

rachel: postmortem kickoff meeting scheduled in 2 days.

elaine: closing thread here, will update postmortem link when ready.
